note: Modules that came off the list, and why. Kept in the open because a quiet delisting teaches nobody anything. Removing an entry stops new installs; it does not reach into folders where somebody already has it.

removed.name: weekly-review
removed.reason: Written to keep the list from being empty rather than because anybody asked for it. A brain that is asked for a weekly review can write one in the same conversation, so shipping it as a package was inventory pretending to be a product.

removed.name: reading-log
removed.reason: Same. A running list of what you are reading is one file and a paragraph of instructions, and asking for it is faster than browsing for it.

removed.name: flashcards
removed.reason: Same, and the worst of the three: recall questions out of a note you already wrote is exactly the kind of job the assistant should build to fit the person, not receive prebuilt.
